# Your Daily Briefing – 5 September 2026

Yesterday was a solid effort — 14.1km in 90 minutes with a 145bpm average HR shows you're working aerobically without overdoing it, and 22,295 steps plus 3,693 kcal burned is a genuinely big day on your feet. Well done.

Recovery looks good. HRV at 102ms sits just inside your baseline of 99–119ms, resting HR is a healthy 48bpm, and stress at 39/100 is nice and low. Sleep at 7.1 hours is decent but slightly short. Overall, your body handled yesterday well — go ahead with today's planned session as normal.

You burned roughly 1,400 kcal above your 2,300 target yesterday, so prioritise protein today — hit that 175g and consider adding a carbohydrate-rich meal post-run to replenish glycogen. Don't let the deficit compound too aggressively; underfuelling stalls progress.
